crossRefs.note: The men of Israel went out of Mizpah, and pursued the Philistines, and struck them, until they came under Beth Kar.

people.name: Beth-car
people.line: Place where the Israelites pursued the Philistines.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Mizpah
people.line: A city in Benjamin; a place of gathering and judgment

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: The men of Israel went out of Mizpah, and pursued the Philistines, and struck them, until they came under Beth Kar.
translations.bsb: Then the men of Israel charged out of Mizpah and pursued the Philistines, striking them down all the way to an area below Beth-car.
translations.kjv: And the men of Israel went out of Mizpeh, and pursued the Philistines, and smote them, until they came under Bethcar.
translations.asv: And the men of Israel went out of Mizpah, and pursued the Philistines, and smote them, until they came under Beth-car.
